cards.t: Paraguay Power Utility to End Special Contracts for Bitcoin Miners
cards.b: Paraguay's state power utility has deemed December 31, 2027, a final expiration date for special power contracts covering 943.8 MW used by bitcoin miners, as AI data centers push them out. Contracts selling power at $44 per megawatt-hour to roughly 4% of global bitcoin miners will not be renewed.

per.BTC: Miners utilizing power in Paraguay face contract terminations by late 2027.
